# Contributing

This repository is not accepting outside contributions.

It is a personal conventions kit, published so the instructions and templates
can be read, copied, and adapted freely. It is not maintained as a community
project, and there is no review capacity for external changes.

What that means in practice:

- **Pull requests** cannot be opened by anyone outside the repository's
  collaborators — interaction is restricted to collaborators. Any that do get
  opened are closed without review.
- **Issues** are disabled. There is no bug tracker or feature-request queue.
- **Forks** are welcome. Read it, learn from it, adapt it for your own setup —
  nothing needs to come back here.

If something here is wrong or out of date, the intended fix is to fork it and
change it in your copy.
